hypothesis: NVIDIAのFY2027残期間92B USD supply/capacity commitmentsは、Q3 FY2027 company guidanceを使うとgross-profit capacityでは十分に吸収できるが、reported H1 FCF conversionのままではcash coverage 1.0xに届かず、FCF margin回復またはQ4増収が必要である。

decision_rule.use_if: Q3 guidance midpointをQ4まで横ばいとしたbase caseで、92B USD commitmentに対するreported H1 FCF marginベースのcash coverageが1.0x以上。
decision_rule.condition_if: gross-profit coverageは1.0x以上で、cash coverage 1.0xに必要なFCF marginがreported H1 marginを上回るが、prior AR-normalized sensitivity以下。
decision_rule.reject_if: Q3 guidance midpointをQ4まで横ばいとしてもgross-profit coverageが1.0x未満、またはcash coverage 1.0xに必要なFCF marginがprior AR-normalized sensitivityを上回る。
decision_rule.unverified_if: Q3 revenue/gross-margin guidance、92B USD commitment、またはcanonical H1 FCF marginが不足する。

capital_allocation_importance: 前回研究で279B USD headlineを期限別に分解した結果、主要な未解決制約はFY2027残期間92B USDに集中した。今回は最新Q3 company guidanceを使い、1.0x cash coverageに必要なFCF marginとQ4 revenueの閾値を直接求める。
primary_sources: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, quarter ended 2026-07-26: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm

method.point_in_time: Use issuer information available through 2026-08-26 plus existing canonical FCF identities; no Q3 actual or later quarter actual is used.
method.base_case: Use Q3 FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint 108.0B USD and GAAP gross-margin guidance 74.0%. For Q4, use the same 108.0B USD revenue as a deliberately simple flat benchmark because Q4 guidance is not yet available.
method.cash_threshold: required FCF margin = 92B / (Q3 revenue + assumed Q4 revenue). Compare with reported H1 FCF margin and prior AR-normalized sensitivity.
method.q4_revenue_threshold: Solve Q4 revenue = 92B / FCF margin - Q3 guidance midpoint. This shows the Q4 revenue required for 1.0x cash coverage at each FCF conversion assumption.
method.alternatives: Compare Q4 revenue equal to Q2 actual, flat at Q3 guidance, and +10% from Q3 guidance; also test the +/-2% Q3 revenue guidance range and +/-50 bps gross-margin range.
method.risk_metrics: NOT_APPLICABLE: point-in-time fundamental commitment/cash-conversion threshold research, not a trading-strategy backtest.

benchmark_and_alternative.simple_benchmark: Prior no-growth Q2 run-rate produced remainder-FY2027 reported FCF coverage of 0.8221x. Replacing Q3 with company guidance and holding Q4 flat at Q3 guidance improves reported cash coverage to 0.9228x.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative_hypothesis: Working-capital normalization, rather than further extraordinary revenue growth, is sufficient to cross 1.0x cash coverage.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative_result: SUPPORTED CONDITIONALLY: prior AR-normalized FCF margin 47.7732% yields 1.1216x coverage in the Q3/Q4-flat case and remains above 1.0x even if Q4 revenue falls back to Q2 actual. However this normalized cash conversion is not yet reported cash.

verdict.reason: Q3 guidance materially improves near-term coverage and gross-profit capacity remains 1.7374x in the midpoint/flat-Q4 base case. However reported H1 FCF conversion yields only 0.9228x cash coverage; 1.0x requires FCF margin 42.5926%, 3.2897pt above reported H1. Alternatively, holding reported H1 FCF margin requires Q4 revenue 126.080B USD, +16.7405% from the Q3 guidance midpoint. Prior AR-normalized sensitivity would clear 1.0x, but that cash recovery is not yet realized.
verdict.capital_allocation_implication: Do not treat the 92B USD FY2027 commitment as fully cash-covered yet. Use 42.5926% H2 FCF margin as the base decision threshold if Q4 revenue is flat at the Q3 guidance midpoint. Upgrade only when reported cash conversion, realized revenue, or disclosed commitment reductions/rescheduling push coverage above 1.0x.

implementation.artifact_type: near-term commitment cash-coverage threshold decision/evaluation artifact
implementation.delete_or_cleanup: No dedicated code/config/workflow/one-off script created; no cleanup required.

limitations: Q3 FY2027 revenue and gross margin are company guidance, not realized results.
Q4 FY2027 revenue is not guided yet; flat-Q3, Q2-reversion and +10% cases are sensitivities, not forecasts.
Supply/capacity commitments are not identical to accounting COGS or same-period cash payments; coverage is an economic capacity diagnostic.
AR-normalized FCF margin is a prior sensitivity and not issuer-reported cash flow.
The analysis does not assume cancellation/rescheduling of supplier commitments even though NVIDIA discloses that some arrangements can be adjusted before firm orders.
next_high_value_hypothesis: NVIDIAのQ3 FY2027 actualが出る前に、92B USD commitmentの1.0x cash coverageを最も左右するworking-capital要因を分解し、AR回収・inventory build・customer advancesのどの組み合わせならH2 FCF margin 42.5926%を超えるかをcash bridgeとして検証する。
